raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "trame-vtk" %}
{% set version = "2.11.14" %}


package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name.replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 64af41bfe1bf7e90894ba81b386ef108a3a8664496129a242e1268df9f0b5126

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - trame-client

test:
  imports:
    - trame
    - trame.modules
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://pypi.org/project/trame-vtk/
  summary: VTK widgets for trame
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - larsoner
    - jourdain
    - psavery
    - kwrobot
